post_result_context: The first mechanism screen was invalidated for a target-cost defect and the corrected screen found no gate. Breakout signs varied by development period while isolated trap/absorption cells were sparse. No validation or 2025 confirmation was opened.
economic_hypothesis: Market-wide abnormal attention is an information-diffusion state favoring continuation, whereas a single-asset attention spike is more likely a local liquidity raid favoring reversal after reclaim. The same policy routes between these mutually exclusive states without looking at outcomes.
causality_and_execution: Identical to preregistration.json plus Amendments 001 and 002: completed bar, next open, cost-invariant structural target, actual funding, stop-first, one global position, no forced close.

policy.systemic_state: number of assets whose current prior-only attention z exceeds the policy threshold is at least systemic_breadth_min
policy.systemic_action: top-attention asset trades aligned 1h/4h breakout continuation
policy.idiosyncratic_state: exactly one asset exceeds the attention threshold
policy.idiosyncratic_action: that asset trades external-range sweep/reclaim reversal with sweep-direction taker flow
